SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name
FROM Students AS s
JOIN Addresses AS current_addr ON current_addr.address_id = s.current_address_id
JOIN Addresses AS permanent_addr ON permanent_addr.address_id = s.permanent_address_id
WHERE current_addr.line_1 IS NOT permanent_addr.line_1
   OR current_addr.line_2 IS NOT permanent_addr.line_2
   OR current_addr.line_3 IS NOT permanent_addr.line_3
   OR current_addr.city IS NOT permanent_addr.city
   OR current_addr.zip_postcode IS NOT permanent_addr.zip_postcode
   OR current_addr.state_province_county IS NOT permanent_addr.state_province_county
   OR current_addr.country IS NOT permanent_addr.country
   OR current_addr.other_address_details IS NOT permanent_addr.other_address_details
